mcp_tools.name: fare_construction_savings_strategy
mcp_tools.title: Fare construction savings strategy
mcp_tools.description: Submits a fare-construction record (trip definition, fare drivers, search strategy, total-cost surface, fare construction, price integrity) and returns a deterministic FARE_CONSTRUCTION_SAVINGS_STRATEGY_READY / FARE_CONSTRUCTION_SAVINGS_STRATEGY_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed total-cost, constructed-total and savings arithmetic, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it searches no fares and books nothing.

inputSchema.description: The fare-construction manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: Full-pass: headline 500 + fees 50 + baggage 20 + seat 30 = 600 total; legs 300+250=550 constructed; baseline 600 - constructed 550 = 50 savings; all differences 0.000000; legs_evaluated 2. [Tester correction R2: designer carried computed quantities only in prose notes - added structured computed_spot_checks with hand-recomputed values.]
